title: Sengoku Clan Gestionary
description: This mod give the player the possibility to use Numismatic Currency to buy a clanmaster title and create a clan, he can also buy new power up for the clan, like clan-chest, some bonus and other (clan = 4 people max)
body:
# Clan System

Create a clan, gather your dynasty, and grow stronger together. This mod adds a full clan system built on top of **Numismatic Overhaul** currency: found a clan, recruit up to 3 members, earn passive income from your clan's playtime, and unlock permanent clan-wide bonuses.

> ⚠️ **Requires [Numismatic Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/numismatic-overhaul)** — clan creation and income are based on its currency.

## ✨ Features

- **Create your own clan** for a price, and lead up to 4 members total (including yourself).
- **Passive income** — every clan member earns silver coins per hour played, shared with the clan.
- **Clan bonuses** — choose a permanent perk that benefits every connected member (more damage, luck, speed, regeneration, and more).
- **Full command-based management** — no GUI needed, everything happens through simple commands.
- **Clan leaderboard** — compare clans by total wealth, kills, and (soon) blocks placed.

## 📜 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/clan create <name>` | Create a new clan |
| `/clan disband` | Disband your clan |
| `/clan invite <player>` | Invite a player to your clan |
| `/clan accept` | Accept the Invite and join a clan |
| `/clan deny` | Deny the Invite |
| `/clan fire <player>` | Kick a member from your clan |
| `/clan promote <player>` | Grant a member permission to use clan commands |
| `/clan give <player>` | Transfer clan leadership to another member |
| `/clan setbonus <bonus>` | Choose your clan's active bonus (autocomplete supported) |

## 📋 Rules

- A clan can have a **maximum of 4 members**.
- A player can only belong to **one clan at a time**.
- Passive income: **2 silver coins per hour, per online member**.
- Founding a clan costs **50 silver coins**.

## 🎁 Available Clan Bonuses

Pick the bonus that suits your clan's playstyle. Some scale with the number of connected members:

- **🗡️ Lame Ancestrale** — +3% damage per connected member (1: +3%, 2: +6%, 3: +9%, 4: +12%, capped at +12%).
- **🍀 Béni des Dieux** — +5 Luck per connected member (1 member: Luck I, 2 members: Luck II, 3+ members: Luck III).
- **📦 Marchands Nomades** — `/envoyer <player>` lets you send 1 stack of items every 15 minutes.
- **⚒️ Industrie de Clan** — Fortune bonus scaling with connected members (1: Fortune I, 2: Fortune II, 3+: Fortune III).
- **🕵️ Réseau d'Espionnage** — `/spy <player>` once per day, reveals an approximate distance (±150 blocks).
- **🌾 Réforme Agricole** — If all members are connected: permanent Saturation; passive Speed I.
- **🩹 Médecine Ancestrale** — If all members are connected: permanent Regeneration I; passive Resistance I (modified).
- **🌊 Colon du Shogun** — Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace.
- **🏗️ Constructeurs Défenseurs** — Haste I (1-2 members) or Haste II (3+ members).
- **🔥 Enfants du Feu** — Fire Resistance and Jump Boost I.
- **👑 Sang Royal** — +2 max hearts for all members; passive natural regeneration 20% faster.
- **🌑 Ombres Vagabondes** — Permanent night vision; if all members are connected, invisibility for 5 seconds after crouching for 10 seconds.

> **Those bonuses aren't fuly working at the moment !**
but we work on it and there will be more and more functioning bonuses in the next updates, actually you can only choose a bonus with the command but we will work to implement a skill tree for the clan and make the Permanent bonus for all the members part of this tree.

> 🔧 More bonuses, a clan skill tree, and a clan chest are planned for future updates!
